# Kollabora Cafe

> The Best Thematic Cafe & Restaurant in Surabaya, Indonesia.

## About
Kollabora Cafe is a premier thematic cafe and restaurant located in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia. It provides table-side self-ordering and cashier checkout for coffee lovers, food enthusiasts, and cafe visitors.

- Address: Jl. Raya Kupang Indah No.51, Sonokwijenan, Kec. Sukomanunggal, Surabaya, Jawa Timur 60225
- Phone: +62 812-3456-7890
- Online Self-Service Terminal: https://kollabora-cafe.vercel.app/

## Menu Categories & Specialties
- Coffe: Americano (Single/Double espresso, Ice/Hot)
- Coklat: Mocha Latte, Signature Rich Cocoa
- Makanan: Carbonara Pasta, Gourmet Rice Bowls
- Camilan: French Fries, Light Bites
